source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Definition, completion, real-time order, locality, and proof method were checked against Herlihy-Wing; testing/verification against Wing-Gong, Lowe, Gibbons-Korach, and Porcupine; simulation/refinement against Lynch, Bouajjani et al., and Filipovic et al.; strong-linearizability scope against Attiya-Enea; and standard algorithm practice against Herlihy-Shavit. Eight sources resolved directly; Wiley and SIAM publisher pages denied automated retrieval, so those citations support scoped bibliographic/result attribution only, not inaccessible quotations or details.

notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked strict precedence direction, interval containment, completion terminology, existential witness language, and abstract/concrete state distinctions.

proof_review.notes: This is an internal proof-method review, not a mechanized proof of a particular source implementation, weak-memory semantics, infinite-state algorithm, checker, or safety system.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external concurrency-theory, formal-methods, C++/Java/Rust, compiler, memory-model, distributed-systems, storage, medical, radiation, regulatory, operational, cybersecurity, or safety review is claimed.
